newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic core units pushed Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic core units pushed Q3 results.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp said on Thursday that continued strength in its core wireline and wireless business produced third quarter earnings that were 9.4 percent higher than the adjusted 1995 figure.

Bell Atlantic said it third quarter net income of $483.3 million, or $1.10 per share, included significant start-up costs for its long-distance and Internet businesses, the costs of complying with the Telecommunications Act of 1996 and revenue reductions from price promotions and product packaging initiatives.
The company said Bell Atlantic's Network revenues grew 7 percent in the quarter, when compared with the comparable 1995 period adjusted for access charge reductions and price cuts in the toll market.

Service access lines on September 30 were about 20.4 million, representing a 3.7 increase during the past 12 months. Access minutes of use grew 8.5 percent compared with the third quarter of 1995, the company said.

The company also reported a more than 60 percent increase in gross sales of secondary residential telephone lines in the quarter to nearly 233,000 and attributed the rise to continued growth in home computer use.

Bell Atlantic said equity income from its wireless investment portfolio rose 53.6 percent from year-ago results, and equity income from Bell Atlantic NYNEX Mobile was $98.3 million, or 41 percent higher than a year ago.

Network operating expenses for the quarter were $2.5 billion, or 5.4 percent higher than in the 1995 period, the company said. Adjusting for increased new-business start-up costs for long-distance and Internet, expenses were up 4.5 percent, driven by demand growth, increased sales and marketing activities, systems and software upgrades, and compliance with the Telecommunications Act, Bell said.
